name: new_blank_project
description: F-2: start from nothing. File > New Project... is filled in the way a person fills it -- a folder under this run's own artifacts, a name, the Blank pipeline template -- and Create writes the template and opens it through the window's ordinary Open Project. The engine that comes up runs the one pass the template authored, `present`, followed by the `output_transform` the engine always adds. VI-2: present draws with the engine's own engine://passthrough, so the template writes no shader; with no input that shader draws a gradient, and the viewport shows it rather than one flat colour.
